children: The deal tasks Boeing with building the next-generation jets that will eventually replace the carrier-launched F/A-18 Super Hornet in the 2030s, the Navy said. Boeing beat Northrop Grumman, its only rival in the competition after Lockheed Martin dropped out of the running last year.
